title: lapsana glandulifera
intro: Lapsana glandulifera, commonly known as Nervilia or Nervilia furusei, is a type of flowering plant. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lapsana glandulifera may include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular-protective effects, although more research is needed to confirm these findings. The bioactive constituents of this plant are reported to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic properties.
